metrics.description: One entry per metric: wall_time_ns, cpu_cycles, cache_misses, peak_rss_bytes

overall_verdict.description: regression if ANY metric regressed; improvement if any improved and none regressed; no_change otherwise

std_dev.description: Sample standard deviation with Bessel correction (n-1 denominator)

q1.description: First quartile via exclusive median-of-halves: median of first n//2 sorted elements

q3.description: Third quartile via exclusive median-of-halves: median of last n-(n+1)//2 sorted elements

outlier_indices.description: Indices (into original unsorted data) of samples identified as outliers. For n<4, return empty.

test_statistic.description: Two-sample test statistic comparing clean (outlier-removed) data

degrees_of_freedom.description: Degrees of freedom for the test (may be fractional for unequal-variance tests)

p_value_raw.description: Unadjusted two-tailed p-value from the theoretical continuous distribution

p_value_adjusted.description: P-value after family-wise error rate correction across all metrics

effect_size.description: Non-parametric dominance-based effect size on clean data

effect_size_class.description: Classification of |effect_size|: <0.147 negligible, <0.33 small, <0.474 medium, >=0.474 large

ci_lower.description: Lower bound of 95% resampling-based confidence interval for the difference (on clean data)

verdict.description: no_change if p_value_adjusted >= alpha; regression if significant and pct_change > 0; improvement if significant and pct_change < 0
